comment: The two small buttons lettered + and - are the parameters the maker never named, so both carry blank tooltips; they insert and delete a slot. An output with no cable is not computed at all. The second output reads the faders of another slot through the same modulation and snapping as the first, Faders.cpp:664-668, which is what lets a whole bank be swept without the panel moving. With Use Adr for Prog on, the Program jack writes into the slot at the Pattern Adr jack and the faders on the panel are left alone, Faders.cpp:643-648.
